reference_each: first actual shaft angle crossing2rad; each trajectory independently
B_continuity: no low-speed sample strictly before reference+lower window; definite early sample FALSE, ambiguous reference-boundary sample UNKNOWN
chemical_outcome: UNKNOWN; joint temporal result is not chemistry
strong_baseline: public system identification in same reactive graph; no learner or RGB input
global_bus_relay: reliable fixture stop both, irreversible within attempt; outside selective serial channel
command_ACK: received, not plant success; controller sees failure only after delivered power packet and fault wait
parent_fixed_joint_comparator: 108 original joint-contract runs retained with raw identity; not counted as new executions

response_estimator.family: known input torque, contact-free implicit-Euler linear rotor; estimate inertia and damping from delivered pre-reference powered velocity pairs
response_estimator.freeze: first delivered A reference; never revise using outcomes or fault identity

retry_policies.online_ID_joint: same complete-branch joint scheduler, updating only A response models
retry_policies.online_ID_success_branch: admit retry when its success branch satisfies both windows; preserve B after observed retry failure, retain original A miss; not a worst-case certificate

fresh_response_evidence: selected after earlier development findings, frozen before new runs; neither blinded test set nor task-graph generalization
reference_prediction: freeze only delivered early eight-pair fit and initial positions; predicted reference drives scheduling, actual reference drives scoring
first_A_rule: earliest dispatch allowing ACK at or after predicted A reference upper bound; shared channel delay retained
oracle_scope: privileged reference-preserving expanded command graph; actual costs/FIFO retained, feedback guards relaxed; complete search by first-effect normal forms
